result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks it. I only compiled the `reports` module (it built cleanly). I ran no tests and did not exercise a renamed-aspect config.

The change is in the zip block of `DataExporter.java`, in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/`. It used to hard-code five file names, including `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. Reading that file failed after a rename, and the exception skipped both zips. The block now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, the same helper that writes the loose text files. It reads that file and adds it to the zip under the same name.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the exception no longer happens, `git-history.zip` is written again too, when a `git-history.txt` exists.
